api: SQL CREATE INDEX ... USING BTREE; EXPLAIN simple equality/range filters

extension.base_contract: A B-tree index supplies an index access path for indexed predicates and EXPLAIN identifies the chosen path.
extension.difference: Alopex supports the issue-scoped simple equality and range planner paths, not PostgreSQL's complete B-tree operator-class surface.
extension.reason: Issue #425 defines the supported v0.8.13 planner boundary.
